annotations.title: Chinese Driver License Translation Sheet & Vehicle Class Mapper

description: Convert overseas license categories to PRC C1, C2, or E/D equivalents, deterministically synthesize an official 3-character Chinese applicant name, and output a structured DMV filing dossier.

foreignLicenseClass.description: License class printed on home license (e.g., "Class C", "Automatic only", "Class M Motorcycle").

fullName.description: Applicant full Latin name exactly as shown on foreign passport (e.g., "John David Smith").

gender.description: Preferred naming character pool when synthesizing the 3-character Chinese name.

issuingCountry.description: Country/state that issued the original driver license.

nationality.description: Passport nationality for translation form header.

originalLicenseNumber.description: Alphanumeric license number printed on the foreign driving permit.
